NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a small young hound, he likes to play and be involved and is fun company to be around. He lives on the south coast and is no stranger to the visiting wildlife.

NAME: Mj (Mary Jane)
TEXT: This pretty young girl is very affectionate and social. She is a small curious hound who looks to suit a courtyard or townhouse environment. She likes to play and go for a walk and she loves to relax and take it easy.

NAME: Star
TEXT: Star is a gentle and affectionate greyhound who adores human companionship but is also perfectly content spending time alone during a busy workday. She’s incredibly respectful and gentle when receiving pats, making her a delight to be around. Star enjoys lazing the day away, especially in a clam swimming pool, and is easy to walk on a lead. Having been raised around farm animals and wildlife, she is well-mannered in different environments and is considered cat workable. Currently living with another greyhound, Star would make a wonderful addition to a loving home, whether as a solo companion or alongside other pets.

NAME: Arlee
TEXT: Are you looking for a young, vibrant, fun loving guy with a big personality? Did we mention handsome - too? Arlee is a total character, with a zest for life here at the centre. He is a confident lad who will entertain you with his antics like rolling around on the couch and being a goof! Still being young & growing up, he would prefer a yard to burn off energy, and would suit a home who enjoys enrichment games and ways to keep his mind stimulated. An owner who enjoys dog training is a bonus as he engages well and loves doing anything for a treat. Arlee would enjoy a home with another dog who has a similar exuberant spirit to him, or a dog who would bring out the calm side in him too. While he figures out the world he would need his humans around for companionship at the start of his adoption journey. Arlee is a catch and we can't wait to find him his forever home - he is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Amy
TEXT: Let's meet Amy, a charming and outgoing canine companion with a heart full of love. She's a friendly girl whose tail starts wagging at the mere sight of her beloved humans. Get ready to receive plenty of affectionate licks when you come home - Amy is excellent in giving kisses! Amy is a water baby at heart; she loves nothing more than splashing around in water on a hot day. Her joy is infectious when she playfully jumps into the pool. It's a sight that's guaranteed to fill your heart with laughter and happiness. She also has a quirky side; Amy enjoys following the mower around, making yard work a joyously shared endeavour. Her vibrant personality and zest for life make her the perfect companion for an equally outgoing and active family. If you enjoy long walks, adventurous hikes, or simply playing in the garden, Amy will be your perfect partner. She fits seamlessly into a family environment and would thrive with a family who appreciates her enthusiastic nature and boundless energy. Bringing Amy into your home and heart means embracing a world of fun-filled afternoons, heart-melting cuddles, and a lifelong, loyal friendship. So, are you ready to add a four-legged bundle of joy into your family? Amy is ready to shower you with love!

NAME: Dawn
TEXT: Rise and shine! Time to greet the day and welcome a stunning new Dawn! Dawn has risen onto the adoption scene - this sweet and calm girl has a burst of play time and then will stand gently by your side for pats. This refreshing lady, just like the sun rising on a new day, can be a little sensitive at first but slowly brightens with a little encouragement and treats of course. A quiet area would be best for this little lady with a nice yard to zoom and lounge around in during the day. We think she would also be fine in a home with older kids who would enjoy her affectionate and playful side. Dawn can either be on her own with full/part time workers or with a canine friend as she seems to get along well with other dogs she has met with us - including small dogs. Living with this little cutie will be full of love and fun from dusk till dawn! Apply online now to take Dawn home - she is available at the Western Sydney adoptio centre.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a playful and gentle young hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals.

NAME: Senjo
TEXT: Senjo is a delightful girl to be around and is looking for the perfect person to help her come out of her shell. Senjo is a little nervous in life but when she knows you is able to give a whole lot of love. Senjo walks very well on lead and is fine with people who work fulltime hours. Senjo enjoys lazing the day away giving you love during the evening. With a gentle afternoon walk in a comfortable and familiar place or a play in the backyard Senjo is ideal for companionship.

NAME: Toby
TEXT: *Toby is in a foster care home with a female greyhound and a male Jack Russell - reach out to the team to organise a meet and greet** Update from foster: "Toby and the small dog are very cheeky with each other, playing and teasing together. Toby is a collector; mainly shoes or socks. He likes to rip up plastic and paper bags. He is full of energy, follows you everywhere. He has to be wherever you are! Then he suddenly decides he'll have a sleep, and be "out to it" for a few hours. Overall, Toby is a very social dog, both with other dogs and people. We've never had an issue with him toileting inside. He sleeps right through the night. He loves his food, but is not a gulper & he's very well behaved on walks." "Very gentle soul, great with other dogs and people. Mopey, soulful brown eyes. Now very obedient with commands such as "come" and "no". He never wees inside. Toby regularly follows you everywhere, but you do get accustomed to it. You just get on with whatever you're doing. Having both dogs with him meant he was pretty much ok when we went out. He was always very keen to see you when you came home, but so are our two. Rory is better suited to a forever home with regular companionship, whether it be a human or another doggie pal." Hi, I'm Toby, a sweet, calm natured, affectionate boy looking for his forever home. I am a low maintenance boy who doesn't ask for much. I would love a home with another greyhound, small dog or calm doggie friend, even respectful children. I am confident meeting new people, learning new things and eager to please. I enjoy cuddling with the jack russel in foster care, too! I don't mind a few hours alone as a solo dog however I am now used to a foster home with other dogs as companionship and require a canine companion if you work longer hours. If Toby sounds like the adorable, loveable boy you have been searching for contact GAP today! **Toby is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Zeus
TEXT: **I am living in a unit/apartment foster home - get in touch with the team to meet me!** Zeus is a super happy boy who is all set to go into a home that can shower him with the attention and toys he deserves. He would thrive in a household where he is able to spend majority of his time left inside or that could provide inside access, which makes him the perfect companion for apartment living. This independent boy doesn't mind if you're at work for most the day, as long as he can still receive his walks and quality time when you arrive home! Zeus has a big love for toys and will offer them to you if you'd be happy to play with him. This brave boy has also been learning stairs and with a bit of practice will likely master them in no time! Zeus is available at our Londonderry site now and is ready to find a family that can be as devoted to him as he will be to them.

NAME: Jimmy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Gentle, tanned, handsome, laid back and cat-suitable, this incredibly handsome and loveable boy can't wait to find his forever home. Jimmy is a gentle & gorgeous boy with the most enchanting puppy dog eyes and big fox-like ears. Jimmy is a happy boy and loves people. He would do really well in a nurturing & quiet home that he can explore at his own pace. He would suit a home without other dogs but can live with cats. He would love a backyard to stretch is long legs out in and play with his toys. A daily walk or even just playing in the backyard is all this boy needs to keep him happy! A family who can keep him company, or work from home, or retired would best suit Jimmy. Jimmy likes to meet other greyhounds on walks but at this point would prefer to be the only dog in your home. A family with older children who have experience with bigger dogs could be suited to Jimmy. If Jimmy sounds like the perfect addition to your home then apply to adopt him today!

NAME: Comet
TEXT: Comet is a little star who shines bright! This sweet girl can be a little reserved at first, but once Comet feels secure and builds trust with her new family, her affectionate and loving nature will shine through! She’s friendly with dogs of all sizes that she's met so far, and is always happy to make new mates on her cosmic adventures - pending a meet & greet at our Londonderry facility. On walks, she’s a dream – graceful, steady, and always up for a bit of fun, and she can also conquer stairs with confidence. She’s perfectly content spending time alone, happily snoozing until her favourite humans return from their earthly duties. She loves spending time indoors, away from all the hustle and bustle, making her perfect for apartment living. The only thing missing from her universe? A forever home that will love her to the moon and back! If you’re a home who can offer patience and a calm environment, Comet is ready to charm her way into your life!

NAME: Ella
TEXT: Ella is a beautiful unraced female greyhound who has been raised on a farm and is well-accustomed to family life. Over the past six weeks, she has thrived in her foster home with two children, proving herself to be a loving and well-adjusted companion. One of Ella’s standout qualities is her impeccable leash manners—she walks so gently that even a five-year-old can handle her with ease. She is crate-trained overnight (10 PM–8:30 AM) and has had no toilet issues, making her a reliable and easy-going addition to any household. While Ella is wonderful with children, she does have sleep startle and prefers a calm environment where young ones understand pet boundaries. She is best suited to a home with children who respect her space and don’t crowd or rush her. If you’re looking for a gentle, family-friendly greyhound who has already settled into pet life, Ella could be the perfect match for you! Ideally Ella would be suited to a family with older children or people who are looking for a companion. With a daily walk Ella would also suit an apartment style of life

NAME: Flash
TEXT: Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as a simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like down, shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! Vaughn is sociable, especially with small dogs. He has lived with other dogs before so is quite adapted to that. He’s gentle and reserved around them, but when it comes to dogs his size, he has a playful side that’s sure to make you Vaughn-der how you ever got by without him. He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Brockie
TEXT: This lad is very social and affectionate, he is great with kids, gets along with all the dogs he has met big and small. Would be great for a family.

NAME: Marco
TEXT: Marco is a very pleasant and affectionate boy. He is social and confident. He is playful and fun to be around, he fetches toys and plays well with kids.

NAME: Skylar
TEXT: Skylar is a gentle and loving girl looking for someone who is on the lazier side to enjoy life with. Skylar is a beautiful fawn girl who enjoys sleeping the day away whilst you are at work. Skylar has spent time living in a townhouse and is more comfortable inside by your side then outside. Skylar walks very well on lead and jumps in and out of the car to go for drives. Skylar is still very social with people in the streets but does enjoy relaxing on her bed watching your favourite tv show with you.

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sam! I'm a friendly, affectionate and lovable boy here at the Western Sydney adoption centre! My handlers have loved getting to know me, because I am so polite and wonderful. I am good inside the house and would do well as an indoor doggie, maybe you have a small courtyard for me to sunbake in? My polite manners extend to my social skills, too. I am lovely with other medium-large dogs here at the centre, too, making me a perfect addition to your home if you already have a doggie looking for companionship. I would prefer human or canine companionship while I'm first in my new home. Older kids who enjoy an affectionate hound would suit me perfectly! Come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Brayden
TEXT: *Brayden is currently living his best life in a foster home - Reach out to GAP for further information* Foster Care Update: "Brayden is cat friendly, ignoring my indoor cat totally, he actually walks around my cat, and stepped over him once when asleep. If my cat stands his ground sitting and lifts his paw waiting to swipe Brayden will not walk past, he's not aggressive at all towards the cat. He watched chickens in the coop & he did nothing. He can now navigate 4 stairs up/down with ease. Was not scared of thunder and lightning or fireworks at all while inside on his bed laying down." Brayden is a super affectionate and adorable boy who is ready to find his forever home! He is currently enjoying his time living in a foster home where he is learning all about pet life and proving what an amazing boy he is! He spends his time hanging around with their 3 cats and has meet a few new doggie friends too - Including a Chihuahua, Poodle and Staffy! He loves going on his walks and spending time playing in the backyard, but is also happy to chill inside on his bed and is prepared to receive lots of back, neck and chin scratches when his family return home. This friendly boy would be a great addition to a busy household and families with respectful kids who can appreciate Brayden's playful nature. If Brayden sounds like the perfect dog for you, please reach out to the team at Western Sydney to enquire about meeting him now!

NAME: Whiskey
TEXT: Whiskey is a kind and lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection. He’s a true snuggle bug who loves to cuddle up and show his gentle, loving nature. With the right introduction, Whiskey has the potential to become great friends with your other dogs and even feline pals. If you're looking for a sweet, easygoing companion to add to your family, Whiskey could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Stripes
TEXT: Stripes is the greyhound who’s stripes ahead of the rest when it comes to love and personality! This sweet boy is as lined with confidence as he is with charm. He’s ready to shape your world with his loving presence and will line up for cuddles or quiet time whenever you need him. Stripes is great at drawing boundaries when it comes to being chill on his own – perfect for apartment living and handling those long workdays without a hitch! He gets along well with medium to large dogs and is always ready to fit into new friendships. But his favourite thing? Being lined up beside you, enjoying quality time with his favourite person. If you're looking for a dog who’s got a well-rounded personality and is ready to shape your life in the best possible way, Stripes is the one for you! Start lining up to the Western Sydney Adoption Center to meet him today!

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: How cute is Ryan? His smile and his puppy eyes are sure to win you over. Ryan could suit many home types. Keep reading to find out why we love him. Ryan would suit a full time working family, with backyard access, preferably in a quieter neck of the woods. This sweet goofball would suit older kids, as he can be a bit goofy sometimes! But he does calm down. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan has some big feelings about going out in the big wide world sometimes, but has conquered the Richmond main drag (pictured!). He is ideally looking for a family who have a relaxed lifestyle who can support him in taking it slow just at the start. Did we mention he's super smart, too? He knows 'on your bed' down & shake – he actually finds training quite soothing so an owner who likes to engage in training would be a perfect match! Ryan is waiting here for you at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Alex
TEXT: Meet Alex, an incredibly fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of energy and charisma! He loves playing games with toys and is always up for a good fetch session. Alex would thrive in a home with a spacious backyard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. He’s especially fond of older kids who can keep up with his playful nature. If you're looking for a joyful, active companion, Alex might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope, a loyal companion ready to bring joy and companionship to her lucky new family. She lives up to her name with her quiet demeanor and dignified presence, making her the perfect "queen" of her domain. Hope has completed an eight-week training program, learning touch, recall, paws up and other fun behaviours. She thrives as an only pet, making her ideal for a home where she can be the centre of your attention. This loyal lady loves her treats and relishes playtime with her beloved shell pool. Imagine the joy of watching her happily splashing around, leaving wet paw prints and smiles in her wake. She delights in lounging around a yard where she can bask in the sun and enjoy quiet moments. Hope is ready to make a home her own, will you be the one to welcome her into your life? Hope is available for foster for the right person who would be happy to give her a comfortable retirement home in her aging years.

NAME: Archer
TEXT: Why yes, this is the most handsome greyhound you've ever seen. Introducing Archer, our new gentle blue boy who ticks all the boxes. Archer is a phenomenal dog. Not only is he small dog friendly and even suited to live with felines with a proper introduction, he has an incredible non jumpy, laid back nature. Never too over the top and never boisterous, Archer is a smoochy gentle boy....if you like personal space, this not the dog for you. If you want an affectionate and gentle boy, keep reading! Good looks, and smart too. Archer is learning recall, name, conditioned reinforce (yes), "bed" and "off" with his dedicated trainer. Archer is excellent on the lead with no pulling. He plays nicely with other greyhounds, spending time in our office with other greyhounds to simulate a home environment. He has excelled with stairs, too. We think he would enjoy apartment living or a backyard home, as he is laid back as they come. Archer is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Katie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Playful, friendly and confident, white and black spotty 2 year old Katie is adorable inside and out! Katie walks nicely on the lead, loves greeting people and checking out what's going on. She loves everyone she meets and is a total social butterfly. We think she would do best in a home with canine, or human companionship throughout the day to make sure this extroverted girl gets all the attention she deserves. She gets along with big or small dogs, making her well suited to a home with another dog of any size. Her happy nature would see her best suiting a home with older children, as sometimes when she's excited she forgets her size! She is still young and has a lot to learn about pet life but she has an amazing can do attitude & can't wait to be a part of your world forever! Katie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Yum Cha
TEXT: Foster Update: "He is a fun and loving boy in the home, and every day he would show more and more of his personality. He settled in very quickly to the ins and outs of home life. Any family who adopts him is going to be so lucky to have him around" A perfect mix of all of your favourite dishes - quirkiness, affection and incredible looks - all served to you on a silver platter. Yum Cha is a fun and lovable young boy! He loves going on short adventures and exploring new places. He's more of a country boy than a city boy though, and would prefer a home away from the hustle and bustle of busy city life. Yum Cha is a pretty chilled boy and only requires a small yard, and short controlled daily walks. At the moment, he can settle on and off for a few hours at a time, but we think he could build to full-time hours alone once he's comfortable in his new home. Yum Cha mingles well with the greyhounds here at GAP and would be suited to living with another calm/gentle large breed companion. He requires a home without children and a flat/accessible home without slippery surfaces or stairs, and a home where he cannot zoom around too much! If you're craving Yum Cha, then, call up and order today!

NAME: Gi Gi
TEXT: Gi-Gi is a soft and and gentle girl who is looking for a loving female companion. Gi-Gi takes her time to get to know people and prefers the quieter life. Gi-Gi would make a great apartment dog who doesn't mind cuddling up in her bed indoors or outdoors whilst you are out and about. Gi-Gi is timid in new situations but with time warms up and is a loving small girl. given time Gi-Gi will open up to her perfect home and give an abundance of love and will be happy to receive endless love and affection.

NAME: Devil
TEXT: Devil is a handsome and lively 4-year-old greyhound with striking coloring inspired by the Tasmanian devil. He’s a playful and affectionate boy who adores attention and thrives on human companionship. While he gets excited during playtime and when he sees his lead—often jumping with joy—he quickly settles down and walks beautifully on a lead. Devil has been socialised around other greyhounds, and would make a fun and loving addition to an active person looking for a loyal companion.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Small dog friendly, gentle and sweet, laid back and super handsome...what more could you want? Benny is a sweet calm boy looking for a family. He could happily live along side big or small doggies, and respectful children. A home with a small yard to stretch his legs in will make Benny very happy! He walks nicely on the lead, too, making him a great addition to a laid back home or someone looking for a chilled out companion. Benny is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bronson
TEXT: Bronson is a happy, young and excitable boy, eager to please and learn about the world! He is outgoing and charistmatic! He likes kisses and is super friendly, and devours his treats, showing great promise for fun training sessions! Older kids would enjoy his playful and engaging personality. He would enjoy a daily walkie and games in the yard while he grows up, and then some laid back time once he settles into your routine as your beloved sidekick! Bronson is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth is a sweet gentle soul who is a darling on the lead and an overall laid back boy. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children and big or small doggies. Suitable for a backyard/townhouse, this laid back boy suits many home types! He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Are you looking for a calm, mega chill, laid back boy to join your world? Maybe you've seen those amazing pet greyhounds out on walkies in the big wide world and thought you'd like your very own amazing boy? Well I'm laid back, confident, walk well with my head held high! I'm ready to meet you and show you how amazing I am! I'm relaxed, quiet, gentle, and laid back. I'm super friendly with other dogs including small dogs. I could totally suit a home with respectful children as I am a total love bug. I am available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Devil (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Despite my naughty name, I'm a very sweet boy! I'm a quiet lad looking for a home to enjoy my zoomies and snooze in the sun. I even walk nicely on the lead making me a great friend for daily strolls. I'm known to be calm and friendly, and love a good pat. I would suit a home with respectful children as I am a gentle boy. A home with big or small dogs would suit me well, too, as long as they're chill and likeminded. I can't wait to meet you! I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bro
TEXT: Yo, what’s up? I'm Bro – the new confident, charming boy greyhound on the block. I like to kick it on the couch, enjoy some quality downtime, and have playtime. I'm all about that relaxed, no-drama life. I'm suitable for full time workers if you have a courtyard/backyard, or shorter hours inside a unit apartment home... I'll just need someone who’s got a steady routine and can show me some lovin'. I'm down for walks, but I'm also down to just vibe with you at home, Netflix 'n' chill style. If you're looking for a bro who won’t give you any trouble but will always have your back, come meet me homie. I'm chiller with other medium to large dogs, so if you’ve got a pack at home, I'll fit right in. I'm also pretty chill with humans, so whether you’re a solo adventurer or a family, I'm your dude. I'm your homeboy if you want a low-maintenance but totally awesome new homie & anyone looking for a bro like me who will totally be down for whatever. I'm confident, social, lovely and have such a well rounded personality. So, what do you say? Want to take Bro home and add some extra good vibes to your life? Hit us up and come meet your new best bro!

NAME: Thistle
TEXT: Looking for an adorable and affectionate boy to be the next addition to your family? Look no further than our handsome hound Thistle! Thistle is the perfect combination of affectionate and playful. He is sweet natured, gentle and ready to return all the love he is about to get. This beautiful boy will be the perfect fit for a family who work part time hours and will the help from routine and his favourite treats, Thistle will be able to settle for full time hours in no time! He gets on well with the other hounds here at GAP and would be open to spending his pet life with another medium to large companion. Thistle’s lovely nature makes him suitable for a family with children who know when to give him some space when he needs it. His love of food comes in very handy when its time for training, his favourite activities are learning how to walk on a lead nicely, shake, touch and lay down. If you think your home is the perfect place for Thistle to live out his pet life, please come and meet him at the Western Sydney facility!

NAME: Will
TEXT: As if this isn't the handsomest cutest boy you've ever seen?! Will is a happy young man. He is a confident boy, who walks nicely on lead and has a calm demeanour during group walkies with other greyhounds. He will 'wow' you with his love of food & high food drive, where he shows great engagement during training. As for other dogs, he's very polite with other greyhounds, and would do best with a low small dog populated area. Will requires a backyard to help him settle into the best boy he can be, and shorter hours alone at the start of his pet journey would see him thrive. He has shown us he can settle on his bed inside our office, showing his lovely calm skills he's learnt. He's also known to settle in a crate, however not required in his forever home. Will can be found lounging around at our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose Maree
TEXT: Meet Rose Maree, a truly gorgeous and sweet canine companion ready to steal your heart. Rose Maree enjoys the simple pleasures in life, like lazing in the shade on a sunny day, where she can unwind and watch the world around her. Playtime is something Rose Maree cherishes, and toys are her absolute favourite. This lovely girl thrives on fun and interaction, especially when playing with kids. Her playful energy shines through when she's chasing a ball keeping young ones entertained for hours. . Rose Maree's ideal home is one where she can bask in sunshine and have access to plenty of toys and loving playmates. She loves spending time with her family and taking in the blissful outdoors. If you're looking for a playful companion to add warmth and joy to your family, Rose Maree is ready to join you on a sun-dappled adventure!

NAME: Tree
TEXT: Looking for a dog who’s part rocket, part couch potato, and 100% lovable? Say hello to Tree, a 2.5-year-old Greyhound who’s ready to plant his roots in your heart (and maybe your lap). Tree is a certified people-person in dog form- he thrives on attention, affection, and the occasional belly rub. If you’re home more often than not, Tree will be your shadow, your cuddle buddy, and your biggest fan. He’s got great recall and walks like a dream on the leash, so he’s always up for a stroll, as long as it’s by your side. Playful and full of life, Tree loves to let loose in a yard – he’s got energy to burn would rather zoom than doom-scroll any day. While he’s a big dog with big love to give, he’s still figuring out that not all small dogs appreciate his enthusiasm. Larger canine companions are more his vibe, so he’d prefer a household where the pint-sized pups don’t steal the show. Bonus points: Tree is stair-savvy, lap-approved, and ready to bring a whole lot of fun into your life. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who’s as happy sprinting as he is snuggling, Tree might be your perfect match.

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: Lulu is a delightful and well-rounded greyhound who brings a perfect mix of fun and relaxation to any home. In the yard by herself, Lulu is quiet and calm, making her an easy addition to a full-time working family. She’s wonderful with children and enjoys playing games, especially chasing balls and playing with toys. While she has an energetic, playful side, she quickly settles down and enjoys relaxing with her loved ones. Lulu is a dream to walk on lead and travels comfortably in the car, making her an excellent companion for outings or adventures. If you’re seeking a loyal, playful, and gentle addition to your home, Lulu is ready to meet you.

NAME: Girly
TEXT: Snuggle Muffin Girly, and I’m just the cutest little sunshine you could ever meet! 🌈 I’m looking for my very own bestie who’s ready to share all the glitter, giggles, and cuddles in the world! 💫 At first, I’m a little bit like a shy flower 🌸, so I would LOVE a human who’s home lots, just so I can feel super safe and cozy while I settle into my new routine. But once I know we’re BFFs, I’m ready to show off my sparkling personality and could be built up to spending longer time alone! 🌟 I can totally live in a super cute house or an apartment with courtyard access 🏡 — I even know how to climb stairs like a total boss! I’m looking for a place where we can snuggle on the couch and have fun together, maybe with a little sprinkle of adventure here and there! 🎀 I’d be happiest as your one and only fur baby 🐾— I just want all your love and all the attention for myself! I’ll fill your life with so much joy, love, and sparkle that you’ll never want to be without me. 🌟 So, if you’re ready for the most fabulous and adorable companion EVER, let’s be besties forever! 💕 With lots of love, xoxo Girly 🐾🌈💖

NAME: Bill
TEXT: Salt & pepper faced Bill may look like one of our special seniors but this gorgeous 3 year old boy is still a youngen, and we know him to be super affectionate! He loves to lean on his people for pats, making it hard to get a good photo! Bill would suit a relaxed and laid back home with or without children. A few hours alone will suit Bill well, and full time hours with a doggie companion, too! We think Bill will make an amazing addition to so many home types. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Daniel
TEXT: If you're looking for a dog who's always up for fun, Daniel is your guy! This playful pup is a total toy & water lover, and nothing makes him happier than splashing around in his shell pool or jumping in the air for toys! While he’s great inside and can handle stairs like a champ, he’s got the kind of energy that thrives in a space where he can really run and play. A small yard with daily walkies, or a backyard would be a perfect fit. He would do well with respectful children with big dog experience who enjoy a playful canine companion, or a likeminded medium-large dog if you already have one. Daniel is a social butterfly who loves people. When it comes to alone time, Daniel prefers to be indoors and can be left for full-time hours – though when outside, he would thrive with enrichment and things to do. If you’re ready for a splash of fun, Daniel is the perfect playmate to brighten your life! Daniel is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Turbo
TEXT: Despite the high energy name, Turbo is a polite gentleman when it comes to people & other dogs. He would suit a calm canine friend in his forever home. He’s all about manners and will leave you impressed with how well he interacts with both humans and other greyhounds. Turbo is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. While he’d love to be an inside dog, indoor outdoor access to a backyard or small outdoor space (eg courtyard) where he can stretch his legs and avoid any accidents, would suit him best. Turbo is a polite young man who can't wait to meet you. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sapphire (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Sapphire is currently in foster care, living in an apartment in the inner west* Like her gemstone namesake, Sapphire is a radiant treasure, full of fun, ready to share this with her new family. Though not yet a treat-obsessed pup, she’ll still steal your heart with her joyful, wagging greetings, always showing a glimmer of affection as she interacts with those around her. She would suit a home with respectful children with dog experience who enjoy a lively natured canine companion. Sapphire shines in indoor settings, making her an ideal gem for apartment living. She's comfortable with full-time indoor hours and gracefully handles stairs, showing off her refined agility. Sapphire is open to sharing her space with other greyhounds, though her high-energy personality may be a bit too much for some to handle. If you're looking for a precious companion who’s as lively and radiant as a gemstone, Sapphire might be the perfect gem to add to your home!

NAME: Rolly
TEXT: Are you looking for an extremely affectionate boy to lean on you and join you on all of lifes adventures? Look no further than Rolly. Rolly would suit a home with a few hours alone per day, he settles well on his own and would do best in a backyard on the quieter side. He is suitable to live with other dogs and children as he has experience around both. We're sure his puppy dog eyes and his smiling face will brighten your day! Rolly is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is still a pup. He is vibrant young hound with energy to play and go for walks. He is a good age to mould into the hound that fits into your lifestyle. An active lifestyle would be a good outcome for this youngster.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a stunning young hound. She is good on the lead, likes to play and loves affection. She is a sweet girl who can be left alone and does adore company.

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Maggie is a lovely hound who is great on the lead, has no problems with stairs and is social and happy around random dogs she meets. She relaxes easy on her own and would suit most homes.

NAME: Maddie
TEXT: This stunning girl is very playful and polite. She is a confident young hound who is very social and lovely to be around.

NAME: Muffin
TEXT: Meet Muffin, Our Sweet-Pea! Muffin is a gentle soul with a calm, easy-going nature. She’s incredibly responsive to her people and loves to be around them. Having had two litters in the past, Muffin is now ready to find her forever home where she can be the center of attention as an only dog. Throughout her life, Muffin has been around various breeds, including sausage dogs. While she’s comfortable with other dogs, we believe she would thrive best as the only dog in her new home, where she can soak up all the love and affection. Muffin has also met a cat and is considered cat-workable. A meet and greet with any potential feline friends would be beneficial to ensure a smooth transition.

NAME: Squirt
TEXT: Tiny little girl Squirt is looking for a loving home! Young Squirt is a bit of shy girl who would benefit most from a quiet and relaxed home willing to take new things nice and slow as she adjusts to the wonders of pet life. With a bit of time and patience you will see Squirt’s super sweet personality start to come out and she will wiggle in close to you for a pat and a treat. You might even get to experience her hilarious playful zoomies! Squirt would love a backyard to chill out in and wouldn’t mind at all if her new humans are full-time workers. She absolutely loves other medium/large dogs and would gladly share her new home with one. In fact, we have noticed Squirt finds a lot of confidence having a canine friend to lead the way! Could you be Squirt’s special someone? She is available for foster or adoption at our Western Sydney adoption centre! *Squirt is on daily medication – ask staff for more info!*

NAME: Noel
TEXT: Christmas has come early and boy do we have the best gift for you! Introducing the always merry and bright Noel! Noel is a sweet and gentle boy suited to those looking for a calm natured companion. He is a low maintenance guy who is quite happy to chill at home during the day while his human parents are at work. He is friendly with other medium/large dogs and would gladly share his new home with another calm doggy friend. Noel would do best in a quieter home without young kids, but older kids/teens that respect his space are suitable. Noel has lovely lead manners and would be happy to join you on a daily stroll. The key to his heart is food! He loves his treaties making him easy to train and entertain with enrichment games. So jump on in your sleigh and come on down to the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet Noel!

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: Well well well who is this handsome young lad? Introducing GAP’s newest heartthrob Reggie! Not only is he supremely handsome, Reggie also has a fantastic personality to match! Reggie is a friendly and affectionate boy with a goofy and playful nature that will have you in stitches. He just loves to chase his toys around with limbs flailing around hilariously! Reggie is happy to entertain himself during the day in the backyard and is suitable for full-time working household. He would gladly share his new home with another tolerant canine companion and older kids or teens are also suitable. Reggie has shown potential to socialise with or live with smaller dogs and cats and could suit a home willing to slowly introduce him to smaller pets. So if Reggie is your man, come on down and meet him! He is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chino
TEXT: Order up! One tall and fluffy Chino, brewed to perfection with a dash of sweetness, is ready to find his forever home! Chino is looking for a cozy spot where he can enjoy a laid-back retirement, sipping on the peaceful moments of life. He's got a smooth, mellow, personality, but every now and then, he perks up for a playful burst – just like that shot of espresso when you need it most. His favorite thing? Leaning into you for the ultimate cuddle, because he's all about getting those extra pats! Chino is a friend to dogs of all sizes and would love to share his home with a canine companion. If he's the only pet in your cup of tea, part-time workers are just the right blend for him, but with a doggy friend, he’s content to chill solo for longer hours. Chino’s chill vibe makes him a great fit for families with respectful kids, as long as he’s got his own little nook to unwind in when he needs a break. If you think Chino would be the perfect addition to your family, apply online today – he’s ready to be your new favorite brew!

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Leave it to Ivy to brighten your day, you won’t go wrong with this beauty! Her ideal home is going to be one where her family aren't out all of the day, where someone can be home to pamper her. Ivy would do well in a fully fenced townhouse or backyard, where she can relax during the days and would love a quiet home with less hustle and bustle to disturb this beautiful girl. She is an active girl and would enjoy spending time playing in the yard. Ivy will excel in a home where she is the only pet so she can soak up all the love you can give! If you're interested in Ivy, contact GAP Londonderry or fill out an application to meet her today!

NAME: Chicken
TEXT: This little chicken is ready to find her forever family! She gets along well with other dogs, big or small, as long as they’re calm and friendly – just like her! Chicken is the perfect indoor companion – she settles beautifully and is happy to relax while her humans are at work full-time. But when you’re home, she’ll shower you with love and even paw at you for extra cuddles! She’s a dream on the leash, walking calmly by your side, and her love for treats makes her a joy to train. If you’re looking for a loving, low-maintenance companion who adores snuggles, Chicken is the one for you!

NAME: Sting
TEXT: Get ready to feel the Sting of love from this handsome boy! With his confident personality and loving nature, Sting is ready to take on the world, whether it’s playing in the backyard or having a cuddle session. Sting would thrive with an owner who can match his energy and provide plenty of love and attention. He would be open to sharing his new home with another furry friend, pending a meet & greet with the GAP team. He also has the potential to work up to longer hours alone, but would like he family or another furry companion with him to help settle in the early stages. If you’re looking to welcome a dog who’s full of personality and ready to make your life even more exciting, Sting might be the one for you!

NAME: Ben
TEXT: Meet Ben, a gentle boy who’s looking for a loving and understanding family. Ben is still learning how to be the best pet he can be but with some time and trust, he’ll reveal his sweet and affectionate nature. He’s the perfect companion for those who enjoy quiet moments and are happy to be a home more often than not in the early stages. If you’re ready to offer this thoughtful, loving dog the home he needs, Ben will reward you with a bond that’s as deep as it is special.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Roaring into your heart, one paw at a time! Tiger is ready to bring excitement and joy to your life. While he may need some time to adjust, once he feels at home, Tiger will become your best companion. Scar would love a courtyard or backyard to laze around and have the occasional play in. He could suit a home with another medium/large breed dog if they can respect his more reserved nature. If you're looking for a sweet and affectionate friend, Tiger is waiting to meet you. Can you be the one to give this sweet boy the home he deserves?

NAME: Scar
TEXT: Don’t let his name fool you, Scar is a softie at heart. Though he may take a little time to warm up, once he feels comfortable, Scar’s friendly and affectionate nature will shine through. Scar would thrive in a calm environment with a family who can work with him to learn how to be the best furry companion he could be. Scar is open to sharing his home with another medium/large furry friend - pending a meet & greet at our Londonderry site. With some patience and training he also has potential to be able to be built up to spending longer periods of time alone. If you’re ready to give him the time and care he needs, Scar will reward you with loyalty and love.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Meet Benji, a sweet and excitable boy who’s looking for his perfect forever home! Despite Benji nearing his senior years, he'll still win your heart over with his playful antics and would love a home with a courtyard or backyard to spend his time playing and sunbaking in. Benji has been around children of all ages in his previous home and could do well in a household with experienced children who can appreciate his enthusiastic nature. If you're ready to welcome a loving, loyal friend into your life, Benji can’t wait to meet you and be a part of your family!

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a playful energetic boy. He is very friendly and likes to play and be around people. He is very friendly with kids of all ages he could possilby get clumsy with little kids since he thinks he is a small dog.

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Banjo is a sweet boy who is very relaxed and comfortable. He does like to play, go for walks and enjoys a swim. He would suit multiple homes since he is so laid back and relaxed.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Jax is a fun young hound who likes to play go for walks and enjoys a good rest afterwards. He lives in a suburban backyard and is conditioned to being left alone during full time work hours. He comes when called and enjoys a walk.

NAME: Macca
TEXT: Macca is a gentle boy with a heart full of love that he is ready to share with his new family! He enjoys quiet moments and would love a peaceful environment with a yard where he can unwind, but don’t be fooled—he still enjoys his occasional zoomies! He would do well in a home who can appreciate his shy nature and work on building his confidence so he can be the best pet he can be. If you’re looking for a calm, loving, and loyal companion, Macca is eager to meet you.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Rusty, a lovable and energetic boy who is ready to find his forever home! Rusty is a friendly companion who has had a brief introduction to pet life in his previous home - spending some time indoors, being taken on public walks and also meeting new people, including children! His warm, golden fur is as soft as his heart, and he’ll quickly become your new best friend and would do well in a home where he can get plenty of attention, exercise, and affection. If you're looking for a dog who will bring joy to your life, Rusty might be the perfect fit. Come meet him today—he can’t wait to share his love with you!

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Goose is, well, just a big goose! Only 32 kg, gentle and loves attention. He likes to wander around the sheds with his owner and visits the farm border collie who he loves to play with. He's a good traveller, no house experience, but was walked in town as a puppy. He's used to pottering about, a true farm greyhound used to farm animals and noises but still deserves a chance of finding that comfy couch or spot in the garden, patio or verandah. He's friendly and happy to meet new people with a wag of his tail, loves a swim in the dam and loves his toys. He has been around kids 10+, and when you're not around to follow about, he is happy to amuse himself throwing his toys up in the air, especially his beloved soccer ball. Goose is a gentle, happy-go-lucky boy who would make a wonderful, loyal and easygoing companion. Goose doesn't bark, except occasionally as a reminder for a bit of attention if you've stopped patting or when its dinner time! He lost 2 toes on his back left foot due to an injury as a puppy, which doesn't bother him, otherwise a healthy lad who has so much love to give. 💙

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Gus the Gentle Giant (40kg) is just a goofy, happy, friendly, placid boy. He will walk beside you and potter around with you when you are home. He can walk up the stairs to the verandah where he lies but hasn't lived inside. Gus is social with other people and is good with the 2-year-old and 4-year-old grandsons who visit. He is used to garden noises, lawn mower, whipper snipper, and is not worried about storms. Gus loves a bit of a run, doing a few zoomies and a play in the backyard but is essentially pretty chill and lazy! He doesn't bark at dogs (kelpies) running past the fence but has not been around any small dogs or cats. He is fine being on his own for the day after his morning 'run' and doesn't need a daily walk if he has a decent backyard for exercise. Gus would be a lovely gentle boy for companionship, love and easy care with his lovely temperament.

NAME: Dally
TEXT: Dally is a sweet, loving gorgeous big boy! At 38kg he's a hunk of love who loves people and just wants to be around you. He spends time in the office and loves spending time with the staff and going for walks with them in the yard. Dally is great with other dogs, especially the many retired greyhounds he lives with, and more so with larger dogs than little one or cats. He would be more suited to being around older children, but he wouldn't hurt a fly, just a friendly stickybeak! This laid-back dude would suit anyone wanting a 'happy chappy' furry friend for life. What a special, teddy-bear, cuddle-bug! 🥰

NAME: Matey
TEXT: Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey has spent some time in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a playful companion and would do best in a home without young kids or other pets. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers provided he lives in a quiet area with opaque fencing so he can just relax and snooze the day away in the backyard. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Becky
TEXT: Becky is a fun loving young girl who LOVES snuggles! Despite Becky's fun loving & enthusiastic energy, she still has a lot to learn! Becky doesn't realise she's not a lap dog, and will get right in there for a cuddle! She is still learning her social skills with other dogs and would benefit from further training to learn to be calm and polite around other dogs. We know she definitely means well, though! Maybe too friendly! She needs a home who will give her lots of cuddles and be home more often than not as she thrives on human company. Maybe you work from home and need a snuggle buddy. She has learnt a lot here at the centre on top of growing her confidence and manners. She has even learnt her name/recall, and what the word yes and bed means! Becky would suit respectful children and a house with a yard. Becky is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Captain
TEXT: A’hoy, Captain! Captain ready and waiting for his future home and family, could you be that lucky person?! He is searching through his spyglass in all of the seas, but we think maybe a home on the land would be better. A backyard, a bed, lots of toys and possibly a medium-large canine friend would do him just fine. He gets on well with the other hounds here at GAP and would love to spend his new life hanging out with some new friends. As well as some treats, yummy meals and walkies would make him so happy. Due to his excitable yet gentle nature, Captain will suit a home with children as long as they are respectful and know when to give him some space if he needs it. He's also spent time around kids 7+. If you’re looking for the perfect family pet, one to make you laugh and show you love, one to play in the yard with during the day and chill with you at night, we think Captain is ready to dock, and if this could be in your yard, let us know. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Midas
TEXT: Gentle, calm and a lovely walking companion, Midas will add the glitz and gold to your life. Midas is an affectionate and gentle boy, who shines with attention and love. He would prefer his family around more this summer as he settles in, and with further training could be left for longer hours. Everything he touches will turn to gold...he is a friendly and calm boy looking for a family with or without children to love him forever! Midas is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Queeny
TEXT: Royalty has arrived! This Queeny is a happy, very lovable and friendly young girl who loves life! She would be a great addition for a young couple or family with older kids on her own or with another greyhound or medium to large dog. She just wants to be part of your life, be a sticky beak, play, and have fun. She can also settle down and have a rest when needed. She has been around a lot of people coming and going in an office environment, noises don't worry her, and she is used to a large yard to wander around and play, then sleep inside with other retired greys during the day or in her own indoor kennel. She is used to walking on lead, loves pats and is well-behaved when given love and attention. She would adore a new home to settle into with her own special people be your loyal companion. 🥰

NAME: Billson
TEXT: Bubbly, effervescent and a perfect accompaniment for your life (not only this summer!), Billson is a sweet and joyful hound. He has been around children of all ages and would suit a home with respectful children. A low small dog population is the best fit for Billson as he needs to learn and have more training around them. Upbeat and fun, Billson would suit many home types. He's an energetic lad with some energy to fizz away, so a home with the family members around more often than not would be the best fit for Billson. Grab a slab and join Billson this summer! He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jimbo
TEXT: Jimbo is a polite, happy and laid back boy best described as chilled out and relaxed. As he is entering his senior years he has a wonderful calm energy. Gorgeous inside and out, this boy is so sweet! He has spent time around other greyhounds, and children, and would suit many home types. He's what greyhound people call a "leaner"! He will lean on you for pats! Jimbo would prefer his family around more often than not while he settles in, and a home with a medium to large doggie friend would see him settle for longer hours. Jimbo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Say hello to our fuzzy little Teddy bear! This adorable boy is the sweetest little guy ever! Teddy is a very friendly and social boy who is calm on the lead, snuggly and friendly with other grey's and even polite with smaller dogs on walkies. Teddy is great with other medium/large sized dogs and would happily join a family who already has one and spend the day with them while his humans are out. As a single dog, Teddy will need someone around more often than not to keep him company. Older, respectful kids are suitable for Teddy and would enjoy his goofy playfulness! So come and cuddle our little Teddy today! He is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Trevor
TEXT: Fun, playful, happy and engaging boy Trevor is a sweet friendly boy ready to find a family to call his own. Trevor loves all things fun - treats and toys and good times! Trevor would suit a home with older children who love a bit of playtime, or a family who would let him join all of life's fun activities. Trevor is still learning to be around smaller breeds of dogs and further training would see him thrive into a polite gentleman we know he can be! Trevor currently lives amongst other greyhounds and would enjoy a home with another dog but in lieu of a canine companion, shorter hours alone or workers from home and some mental stimulation while you're out would see Trevor settle right in. Trevor is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cosmic
TEXT: Cosmic is a VERY gentle and sweet boy with a super calm nature. He will be gentle with all people he meets and even gently picks up toys to carry around. He would prefer a quiet neighbourhood and someone to show him how to become the best pet he can be as he can be nervous in new environments but is gentle and calm around new people and dogs. He has picked up quickly that other greyhounds and even small dogs are friends! More exposure to other dogs would make Cosmic more confident and he would thrive in a multi-dog home as he already enjoys living with a greyhound. Without a doggie companion we think shorter hours alone would suit him however longer stints with a dog pal would see Cosmic settle right in! Cosmic is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Panini
TEXT: The perfect panini consists of: a sprinkle of goofiness, a slice of zoomies and a handful of smooches! Panini is ready to join her family on picnics and adventures. This bubbly girl is a super friendly, excited dog with a happy, positive outlook on life. She's interested in all things fun - toys, treats and playtime. If she was to live with children they would need to tolerate her bubbly nature so we recommend kids with big dog experience. A backyard for exploring is a bonus, as she loves playing and having fun! She could live in an apartment if she had a fun and stimulating social life! Panini's ideal forever home is one where her family are home more often, so she can receive the love and attention she craves. Panini is ready to pick up and takeaway from our Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a stunning female red fawn greyhound with a perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Missy can be strong on the lead, making her walks an exciting experience, but she is also incredibly relaxed and calm, adapting well to new environments and settling into a peaceful routine at home. Missy’s playful side shines through when it’s time for fun! She loves engaging with her humans, whether it’s a lively game or simply hanging out and soaking up attention. Her joyful and affectionate nature makes her a delightful companion for an active family or an individual who enjoys both adventure and relaxation. With her combination of strength, playfulness, and a laid-back attitude, Missy is ready to bring her warmth and energy into a loving home. If you’re looking for a dog who will keep you on your toes while also offering plenty of cuddles, Missy could be your perfect match!

NAME: Bambi
TEXT: Meet Bambi, a gorgeous, gentle and confident light brindle greyhound with a calm, easy-going personality. Bambi is quiet and clean in the home, making her an ideal companion for anyone looking for a low-maintenance, well-mannered dog. She has a relaxed demeanor and a wagging tail that reflects her friendly nature. Bambi takes a laid-back approach to life and is especially affectionate with humans, always ready to share a wag of her tail and a warm, loving presence. She is also perfectly suited to living with her housemate, Bailey (who is also available for adoption online) GAPNSW - Bailey. Whether it's relaxing at home or enjoying walks together, Bambi and Bailey make a wonderful pair. If you're looking for a sweet and confident companion who is easygoing and great with others, Bambi could be the perfect addition to your home!

NAME: Gordo
TEXT: Gordo is a very special boy who was born with a special eye condition. Gordo is a special boy who just wants to be friends with everyone. Gordo is great with kids as young as 5 years of age and is a gentle boy who just wants love. Gordo walks well on lead and is looking for someone to welcome in to his life to become best friends with.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: this big 42kg boy might be big but he is a very gentle. Chief is a very relaxed boy who is as quiet as a church mouse. Chief enjoys his life and his walks with his two friends a 5 and 11 year old. chief has a cool hooked tail that makes him stand out from the crowd

NAME: Blackie
TEXT: Blackie is a special boy who settles in to routine very quickly Blackie has recovered from an acl injury like the true athlete he is. Blackie has had 3 months worth of house training and is crate trained. Blackie has daily energy for a walk or play in the backyard before retiring to the crate to sleep the night away.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Delightful Daisy is an affectionate, calm, low-maintenance girl. Like a flower she brings joy around her. She has occasionally been indoors and is semi housetrained. She spends time with the pet German Shepherd and is gentle with the 3½-year granddaughter, enjoying her attention and pats. Daisy loves meeting people and enjoys car rides well. She's quiet, easygoing and would make a wonderful pet for a family, couple, workers, or retirees. She would be excited to see you when you return and also love to spend time wandering around in the garden and house with you if you're home more often. Daisy is happy to be only dog or meet a gentle new dog. She has also encountered a cat and backed away, showing no interest chasing, so she could potentially live with an indoor cat with slow introductions and supervision. 🌼

NAME: Buzz
TEXT: **I'm currently in a foster home - Reach out to GAP for more info!* Buzzing with energy and always on the move, I’m all about making sweet connections and keeping things buzzing with excitement. Whether I’m spreading good vibes, exploring new ideas, or just enjoying the simple pleasures, I’m constantly seeking the next hive of inspiration. Let’s make some honey together and create something truly buzzworthy While I am incredibly confident with being out and about and using stairs, a house with a flat accessible yard is best. I also love small children, however also love licking faces and can have a bit of energy, so older children are preferable to share my home with. I am also A-M-A-Z-I-N-G with training! I know “bed”, my name, “down” and my recall is un-bee-lievable. I would love to bee friends with other dogs of a medium/large size and would happily share my hive with them. So don’t bee a stranger, make a bee-line to the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet me today!

NAME: Casper
TEXT: Meet Casper, a sweet and gentle soul looking for a loving new family. Casper is a serene and relaxed companion who thrives in calm environments, making him an ideal pet for those who appreciate a soothing home. He might be a bit cautious at first, but with patience and understanding, he will reveal his warm and gentle heart. Casper is relaxed and easygoing when it comes to handling. He'll enjoy sitting quietly by your side, whether you're settling in with a good book or enjoying a leisurely weekend afternoon, Casper will be content to share those peaceful moments with you. Due to his cautious nature, Casper would do best in a quieter home, where he can truly shine at his own pace. If you're a calm and patient adopter looking for a relaxed and loving companion, Casper could be the perfect fit for your lifestyle.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is as handsome and adorable as they come, he is super cute, placid, gentle, charming and engaging with people. Alf enjoys snuggling with his greyhound buddies in foster care (see photos!). He is a gentle boy with greyhounds and people alike and for this reason we think he'd suit a home with respectful children. He's used to having yard access so a home with a courtyard/backyard would suit this placid laid back fellow. Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Ringo
TEXT: This is Ringo and he truely is a Star! Ringo is an active boy who gets very excited to go on his daily walk Ringo has grown up with children as young as 5 years old and calls them his best friends Ringo has grown up sharing his yard with his best friends Barbar and Penny Ringo is looking to match with his forever home Ringo will be at the Canberra adoption day on the 14th of December

NAME: Wombat
TEXT: He is not short and stumpy, nor does he eat leaves and grass but he is ready to burrow his way into your heart and home. Wombat is a sweet and gentle boy is seeking a family that can be around more often than not, or a canine companion so he company. He gets along well with other canines, medium to large breeds are ok for him to live with pending a friendly meet and greet at GAP. Respectful kiddos would be suitable, too! If you can give Wombat the burrow he is seeking submit an application form to adopt him now. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 6 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Jagger
TEXT: He’s got the moves like Jagger! This boy certainly knows how to impress! Jagger is a special boy with a personality that can melt your heart. Jagger has a laid-back and easy-going nature, making him suited a home that has a secure backyard/courtyard type environment. Jagger can adapt to a household where family members work full-time, as long as he receives the love and attention he deserves when they return home. Providing him with a comfortable space and engaging toys during the day can help keep him content. Due to his sweet nature, he is an ideal choice for a home with respectful children seeking a loving companion. He has shown to be polite with other medium to large canine companions. He is a social boy and enjoys the companion of his four-legged friends, if you have other dogs in the home, he will surely enjoy showing them his moves! Be sure to apply online today and mention Jagger’s name in your application, you don’t want to miss out on welcoming this loving, gentle and playful boy to your home.

NAME: Woody
TEXT: *Woody is in foster care with 2 greyhound buddies, one male one female - contact the Western Sydney team to meet him* Do you have a doggie squad looking to add a placid but young at heart senior to the mix? My foster carers call me smoochy, cuddly, quirky, smart & obedient, even bossy sometimes! I do learn the rules very quickly though. I love people, any one who can pat me! My foster carers tell me I'm a special "blue fawn" colour which is apparently quite rare! You think that my super friendly nature would make me needy, but in fact, my foster family go away for full time work & I'm totally blasé about it with my 2 doggie pals next to me. Yep, I am known to jump on the couch for a cuddle, too. I'm a lazy bones but happy for a daily stroll where I promise to walk perfectly on the lead. I'm ready to share my multi-dog home life experience, tried and tested pet skills, affectionate nature & goofy ways with you! Come meet Woody today and discover the love that only a senior greyhound can offer.

NAME: Onyx
TEXT: Hi! I’m Onyx and I’m looking a loving family to call my own. I’m a friendly and playful guy and I know I can make a family so happy! I will suit a home where my family are home more often than not, and with some time, love and patience I will be able to settle for much longer once I get used to my new routine. I can be excitable at times and would love a family who enjoys taking me on walks and playing with all my toys. Even though I can be excitable at times, I still have a calm, affectionate and loving side, I cant wait to hang out inside with my new family and nap the afternoon away. If your as eager to meet me as I am to meet you, please come and meet me at the Western Sydney facility and I promise I can show you just how much love I have to give, and how destined I am to be your beloved pet!

NAME: Snowy
TEXT: Meet Snowy, a gentle and graceful soul searching for a patient and loving home. Though initially reserved, Snowy has a placid nature, making her a wonderfully calming grey for those who appreciate a quieter demeanor. Her gentle energy is perfect for someone who values serenity and is willing to give Snowy the space she needs in those initial days. Once Snowy feels comfortable in her surroundings, her personality truly starts to shine. She becomes playful and engaging, revealing a charming side that is sure to win over your heart. For Snowy, a perfect home environment will be one where patience and understanding take center stage. This environment will allow her ample time to adapt, unlock her spirited playfulness, and find her groove in her own time.

NAME: Lizzie
TEXT: Meet Lizzie, an easy-going soul with a placid nature and a relaxed temperament that endears her to everyone she meets. Her gentle disposition makes her an absolute pleasure to have around and the perfect addition to a household. A self-confessed couch potato, Lizzie treasures quiet afternoons spent lounging around on the couch. Her favorite pastimes include soaking in the sun from a warm spot by the window. She's compatible with all canine friends she's encountered, including lively Italian Greyhounds and adorable Mini Spoodle, initially she was nervous but adjusted well and had a relaxed and neutral response.

NAME: Bert
TEXT: Bert is ready to find his forever home, this boy has personality+, boasts confidence and loves to come along for pats and cuddles anytime he wants. Bert is social with other greyhounds and spends a lot of time relaxing or playing. He can still be a bit sporadic on lead and excitable but given his age with a the right training and time, he will adapt quickly. Bert would be suited to a house with a backyard so if he has any energy he can have a good explore and play around.

NAME: Cola
TEXT: Bubbly little girl Cola has spent time around kids 7+ and has a friendly nature, ready to join you alongside your summer BBQ's, picnics, or cuddles on the couch. Cola is a versatile glass of adorable-ness, she is light on the lead and a great walker, and friendly with other medium to large doggies pending a meet and greet, too. This middle aged sweetie is not just sweet by name, she has also spent some time preparing for her next adventure into pet life, including exposure to indoors, appliances, farm animals & has experience being walked on lead by kids (when supervised of course!). Don't go flat, enquire to meet Cola at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Personality plus, yet lazy and laid back when you need him to be, our handsome boy Oakley is perfect for busy families seeking an independent lad with a fun loving streak to join their crew! This cutie is super low maintenance & thrives on simply spending the day relaxing and snoozing outdoors in the yard, making him well suited to full-time workers. When you get home, Oakley will shower you with love and affection! Yep, Oakley really is dreaming of a backyard with opaque fencing to frolic and sunbathe in as he pleases. Oakley is friendly with other medium/large dogs, would suit a home with or without another doggie pal or respectful children & not to mention, he is super engaged during his training sessions here at GAP. Yep, he's a catch! He is available now from our Western Sydney kennels so apply today!

NAME: Harvey
TEXT: Meet Harvey, a sweet and gentle male greyhound with a loyal heart. Harvey is eager to please and looking for a family who can provide him with guidance and instruction as he continues to grow and learn. He loves a good game of fetch and enjoys being active but also knows how to relax and enjoy downtime with his family. Harvey is social with smaller dogs and children, making him a great companion for a family looking for a well-rounded, affectionate dog. With his loving nature and playful spirit, Harvey is ready to become a cherished member of your home.

NAME: Costa
TEXT: Meet Cuddle Me Costa, a sweet and affectionate male greyhound who lives up to his name with big, warm cuddles! Costa is a confident, happy boy who loves to shower his family with love. He’s well-socialized with young children and medium-sized dogs, making him a perfect fit for family life. Costa is equally content doing his own thing or hanging out with the family, whether it’s relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet moment outdoors. With his loving nature and laid-back attitude, Costa is sure to bring joy and comfort to your home.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a friendly and easy-going male greyhound who loves socializing with young children and other medium-sized dogs. This laid-back fellow is happy to go with the flow, whether it’s enjoying a quiet moment at home or joining in on family activities. Rocky is a calm and adaptable companion, making him an ideal choice for a family looking for a well-mannered dog who’s great with kids and other pets. His gentle nature and relaxed attitude mean he’s content to simply be part of the family and enjoy whatever life brings his way.

NAME: Tiggy
TEXT: Tiggy is a sweet, patient female greyhound with a striking Tigger-like orange and black brindle coat. This gentle girl is great with young children and other medium-sized dogs, making her a perfect family companion. Tiggy enjoys living indoors and is content to relax, cuddle, and soak up attention. She’s easy-going, low-maintenance, and requires only a few walks and some playtime each day. Tiggy’s calm nature and loving personality make her an ideal addition to a peaceful home, and she would thrive in a family environment where she can receive the affection and care she deserves.

NAME: Roxy
TEXT: Roxy is a social and affectionate hound. She is very pleasant company and is very lovable. She happily shares her yard during the day with other hounds and has frequent visits from native ducks along with other birds.

NAME: Jay Jay
TEXT: Say g’day to JayJay this beautiful female has had a wonderful life around children as young as 1 year old and also around Medium dogs. Jayjay is 5 years of age and is a perfect mix between puppy playful during the day and settled mature girl of a night. Jay jay is always excited to go for a walk and would be the perfect dog for someone looking at undertaking adventures and longer walks Jayjay travels well in a car and would love a backyard to play the day away in

NAME: Birdie
TEXT: **Birdie is in a foster care home in a unit apartment with a small dog - reach out to the team to meet her** Her foster carers say "she is just gorgeously sweet and really deserves a loving patient home". Birdie is a shy by nature girl looking for a home with a calm and nurturing canine companion to assist her journey into pet life. We have noticed a confident canine companion helps her in becoming more confident. She would do best with older, quiet children, if any, and would be fine for longer hours alone or full time workers as she does enjoy her down time and independence. She has done amazingly well at the centre, she knows how to walk stairs and even jumps in and out of cars. She would thrive in a quiet neighbourhood and a low stimulation home however a quiet unit apartment is suitable. We know that with the right nurturing owner who is ready to build a relationship with her, she will make an amazing companion! Birdie is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Dave is personality plus & ready to spread joy to all who meet him. He's a goofy boy who is energetic, as well as super sweet and affectionate.
